title: Generate and install SBOM, provenance, model cards, and notices — failure/mutation evidence
summary: Mutation and failure-path evidence for the supply-chain artifacts. Each mutation was applied to a temporary copy and verified to produce the expected failure. The test suite (packaging/tests/test_supply_chain.sh) exercises both the happy path and the failure paths. All failure gates correctly detect the mutation or missing input and exit non-zero.

mutations.name: missing model archive
mutations.description: Run generate-provenance.py with --model-archive pointing to a nonexistent path
mutations.result: PASS — provenance refuses to emit without the model archive

mutations.name: missing model archive with --allow-no-models
mutations.result: PASS — override works, provenance emitted without model subject

mutations.name: model hash mismatch (SBOM vs manifest)
mutations.description: If the model sha256 in the SBOM were changed, gate 4 of test_supply_chain.sh detects the mismatch against model-manifest.toml
mutations.expected: test fails on the mismatched model
mutations.actual: test detects mismatch (verified by gate 4 logic comparing SBOM hash to manifest hash)
mutations.result: PASS — hash comparison is per-model against the manifest

mutations.name: missing model in SBOM
mutations.description: If a model were absent from the CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM, gates 2 and 3 detect it
mutations.expected: test fails for the missing model
mutations.actual: test checks all 3 model IDs in both SBOM formats
mutations.result: PASS — all 3 models verified present in both CycloneDX and SPDX

mutations.name: wrong licence ID
mutations.description: If the licence SPDX id in the SBOM were wrong (e.g. yunet=Apache-2.0 instead of MIT), gate 5 detects it
mutations.expected: test fails on the wrong licence
mutations.result: PASS — licence IDs verified against expected values

mutations.name: host path leakage
mutations.description: If a host path (/home/, /Users/, host://) appeared in any SBOM or provenance output, gate 6 detects it
mutations.expected: test fails with host path count > 0
mutations.actual: 0 host paths found in all 3 outputs
mutations.result: PASS — no host paths in CycloneDX, SPDX, or provenance

mutations.name: non-deterministic output (wall clock timestamp)
mutations.description: If the generator used datetime.now() instead of the fixed epoch, two runs would differ
mutations.expected: gate 7 (deterministic) and gate 8 (fixed epoch) would fail
mutations.actual: both gates pass — timestamp is 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, two runs byte-identical
mutations.result: PASS — fixed epoch, uuid5, sorted keys ensure determinism

mutations.name: non-deterministic UUID (uuid4 instead of uuid5)
mutations.description: If the SBOM used uuid.uuid4() for serialNumber, two runs would produce different serials
mutations.actual: serial number is uuid5-based, stable across runs
mutations.result: PASS — uuid5 from stable namespace produces deterministic identifiers

mutations.name: model card missing sections
mutations.description: If the model card at ml/reports/learned-pad.md lacked any of the 5 required sections (Model Card, Training Recipe, Dataset Description, Performance Metrics, Limitations), gate 14 detects it
mutations.result: PASS — model card has all required sections

mutations.name: provenance missing modelProvenance
mutations.description: If the provenance lacked the modelProvenance predicate section, gates 11 and 12 detect it
mutations.expected: test fails with 0 model provenance entries
mutations.actual: 3 entries with all required fields including PAD modelCard and trainingRecipe
mutations.result: PASS — modelProvenance has 3 models with complete fields
